compiled_state.description:
## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md Phase E (Adversarial Review) Step 1 dispatch block to explicitly specify the mode parameter when invoking dso:red-team-reviewer.

The current dispatch block (line ~343) does not pass a mode parameter, which means all preplanning invocations could silently apply the new inference-challenge mode introduced by story 18b0-7c5d. The update must make the mode explicit so agents cannot accidentally trigger inference-challenge mode for story-review invocations.

Add to the dispatch argument list:
- mode: story-review (or equivalent non-inference-challenge literal per the red-team-reviewer contract from 18b0-7c5d)

The comment in the done definitions (2026-04-29 path update note) confirms 'Phase 2.5' is now 'Phase E' — this task targets Phase E Step 1.

Satisfies: ec78-d60d done definition 2 (consumer protection).
